design_brief.route: original design using accepted Machiya08 M08 and two new bounded families
hard_constraints: upper floors furnished with beds where present
grouped grass and flowers; no path planting
design_brief.layout: main shop street, side alleys, meandering creek at east side with bank walks and two bridges; staggered fronts and mixed eaves
design_brief.reference: previous Freedom observation record reused; no new video viewing this turn

randomness.seed_scope: stable named groups; planting variation only, not arbitrary layout generation

limitations: offline preview is not a Minecraft screenshot
furniture seats, tubs and display props are decorative vanilla constructions
some shop entrances show open trading state without closure
NBT is sparse; use supplied world or clear whole bounding box before structure paste
source room layouts are authored family adaptations, not 18 entirely unrelated algorithms
